title: Excessively large side margins for non-floating space-filling panel
line: On a non-floating panel the first and last widgets now sit closer to the screen edges, as in Plasma 5.
explanation: The panel containment sets its side margins to the theme's panel margin plus an extra smallSpacing (4 px), added in 2023 as a workaround for widgets with uneven internal padding. With Breeze that gives 8 px at each end, so on a non-floating panel Kickoff and the last widget stay visibly away from the screen edges, unlike Plasma 5 which used the theme margin alone. The extra spacing is now only added when the panel is set to floating; non-floating panels use the theme margin alone (4 px). Floating panels, including when they de-float, keep the current layout so widgets don't shift.

commits.message:
containments/panel: don't add extra side spacing to non-floating panels

Panels always added a small spacing at both ends on top of the theme's
margins, so on a non-floating panel the first and last widgets stayed
away from the screen edges. Only floating panels now add that spacing.

BUG: 478240

patches.diff:
From 2d444f7ce25233e15ffc4dc5926c0a759a2ae329 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 13:07:14 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/panel: don't add extra side spacing to
 non-floating panels

Panels always added a small spacing at both ends on top of the theme's
margins, so on a non-floating panel the first and last widgets stayed
away from the screen edges. Only floating panels now add that spacing.

BUG: 478240
---
 containments/panel/main.qml | 11 +++++++----
 1 file changed, 7 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/containments/panel/main.qml b/containments/panel/main.qml
index 4ee220333e..489e6baac5 100644
--- a/containments/panel/main.qml
+++ b/containments/panel/main.qml
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@ pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound
 
 import QtQuick
 import QtQuick.Layouts
+import QtQuick.Window
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 
 import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
@@ -180,6 +181,8 @@ ContainmentItem {
         //Margins are either the size of the margins in the SVG, unless that prevents the panel from being at least half a smallMedium icon) tall at which point we set the margin to whatever allows it to be that...or if it still won't fit, 1.
         //the size a margin should be to force a panel to be the required size above
         readonly property real spacingAtMinSize: Math.floor(Math.max(1, (root.isHorizontal ? root.height : root.width) - Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium)/2)
+        // Non-floating panels touch the screen edges, so they don't add extra spacing at the ends
+        readonly property int sideSpacing: (root.Window.window?.floating ?? true) ? currentLayout.rowSpacing : 0
 
         Component.onCompleted: {
             LayoutManager.plasmoid = root.Plasmoid;
@@ -383,10 +386,10 @@ ContainmentItem {
 //BEGIN UI elements
 
         anchors {
-            leftMargin: root.isHorizontal ? Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.left + currentLayout.rowSpacing) : 0
-            rightMargin: root.isHorizontal ? Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.right + currentLayout.rowSpacing) : 0
-            topMargin: root.isHorizontal ? 0 : Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.top + currentLayout.rowSpacing)
-            bottomMargin: root.isHorizontal ? 0 : Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.bottom + currentLayout.rowSpacing)
+            leftMargin: root.isHorizontal ? Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.left + dropArea.sideSpacing) : 0
+            rightMargin: root.isHorizontal ? Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.right + dropArea.sideSpacing) : 0
+            topMargin: root.isHorizontal ? 0 : Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.top + dropArea.sideSpacing)
+            bottomMargin: root.isHorizontal ? 0 : Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.bottom + dropArea.sideSpacing)
         }
 
         Item {
--
